_meta.name: ZenFlow Design Tokens
_meta.description: W3C DTCG design tokens SSOT. Phase 2-B adds color.surface (semantic shadcn aliases in OKLCH) + color.mood (5-step mood palette) as the DUAL-TOKEN BRIDGE. Existing src/index.css HSL color vars in :root REMAIN UNCHANGED and authoritative for Tailwind/shadcn. OKLCH tokens here are the parallel track for per-surface flag-gated migration (useDesignFlag('design.colors.oklch.*')). PostCSS @csstools/postcss-oklab-function preserves the oklch() declarations in the cascade; the @supports-less layer provides rgb() fallback for browsers without Oklab support.

canary.$description: Phase 0-A pipeline canary. Proves DTCG→Style Dictionary→PostCSS OKLCH→CSS fallback chain works end-to-end. DO NOT USE in production — this is infrastructure verification only.

background.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --background (HSL 240 5% 96%). Existing HSL var in src/index.css :root remains authoritative for Tailwind/shadcn. Gated by useDesignFlag('design.colors.oklch.*') per surface migration.

foreground.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --foreground (HSL 0 0% 11%). Achromatic near-black; H residual from cbrt noise is visually indistinguishable.

card.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --card (HSL 0 0% 100%). Pure white L=1.

card-foreground.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --card-foreground. Same as foreground.

primary.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --primary (HSL 158 45% 38%) — ZenFlow brand teal. Chroma 0.098 falls within sRGB gamut (no clamping needed).

primary-foreground.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --primary-foreground (HSL 0 0% 100%). Near-white text on teal buttons.

secondary.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --secondary (HSL 240 5% 90%). Cool grey chip background.

accent.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --accent (HSL 28 75% 55%) — warm orange accent.

destructive.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --destructive (HSL 0 65% 50%) — error/danger red.

input.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --input (HSL 240 5% 90%). Form field border.

ring.$description: Phase 2-B — OKLCH equivalent of --ring (HSL 158 45% 38%). Focus ring teal, matches primary.

terrible.$description: Phase 2-B mood scale step 1/5 — deep red. Matches --destructive start of existing MoodSlider gradient.

bad.$description: Phase 2-B mood scale step 2/5 — warm red-orange. New perceptually-uniform intermediate (HSL 18 70% 55%).

okay.$description: Phase 2-B mood scale step 3/5 — amber/warning. Roughly aligns with --warning HSL 42 80% 60%.

good.$description: Phase 2-B mood scale step 4/5 — soft green. Perceptual midpoint between okay (amber) and great (teal) in Oklab space.

great.$description: Phase 2-B mood scale step 5/5 — teal. Derived from --primary HSL 158 45% 42%. End of MoodSlider gradient.

surface.$description: Paper theme base surface — warm cream ~#F5EFE1. Inspired by iA Writer / Apple Books reading pane. Chroma 0.024 gives subtle warmth without tinting to yellow. Hue 80 = warm-neutral cream.

surface-muted.$description: Paper secondary surface — slightly deeper than base for section backgrounds, hover states, muted UI.

surface-card.$description: Paper elevated surface — near-white cream for cards, modals, elevated surfaces (Apple-style bg/card contrast preserved).

ink.$description: Paper primary text — warm dark ~#221E1A. Contrast vs surface: 12.4:1 (exceeds WCAG AAA 7.0). Hue 60 warm-brown bias makes text feel ink-on-paper rather than cold grey.

ink-muted.$description: Paper secondary text — metadata, footnotes, placeholders. Contrast vs surface: ~5.5:1 AA. Matches warm hue of primary ink for cohesion.

border.$description: Paper UI boundaries — warm taupe. L=0.62 gives 3.4:1 vs surface (L=0.97) for WCAG 1.4.11 non-text contrast. Mathematically derived via contrast binary-search.

primary.$description: Paper accent — warm rust ~#8B4A28. Maps to letterpress ink / vintage book accent. L=0.48 gives 4.7:1 on cream (AA for UI).

primary-fg.$description: Paper primary foreground — near-white cream for text on rust buttons.

surface.$description: Ink theme base surface — deep warm dark ~#16130F. Warmer than cold midnight blue, closer to charcoal on book cloth.

surface-muted.$description: Ink secondary surface — hovered/selected states, input backgrounds.

surface-card.$description: Ink elevated surface — modals, cards; lifts above base.

ink.$description: Ink primary text — warm off-white cream. Contrast vs surface: ~14.2:1 (exceeds WCAG AAA). Warm hue prevents the cold-screen look.

border.$description: Ink UI boundaries — visible on dark backdrop. L=0.50 gives 3.2:1 non-text contrast against the L=0.12 base surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Mathematically derived via contrast binary-search.

primary.$description: Ink accent — brightened warm rust. L=0.65 targets sufficient contrast both on dark surface (3.9:1) and beside cream (AAA for button fg).

primary-fg.$description: Ink primary foreground — deep warm dark for text on rust accents.

surface.$description: OLED theme base surface — true black for pixel-off power savings on OLED displays. Chroma 0 = pure achromatic.

surface-muted.$description: OLED secondary surface — near-black with subtle warm tint for hover states.

surface-card.$description: OLED elevated surface — cards lift via minimal L-difference (not chromaticity).

ink.$description: OLED primary text — warm cream. Contrast vs true-black surface: ~18.2:1 (AAA+).

border.$description: OLED UI boundaries — L=0.48 gives 3.1:1 non-text contrast against true-black surface (WCAG 1.4.11). Mathematically derived via contrast binary-search.

primary.$description: OLED accent — same brightened rust as ink theme.

primary-fg.$description: OLED primary foreground — true black for text on rust accents.

display.$description: Display slot — entry titles, drop-caps, streak counters, quote watermarks. Phase 0-B.1 dual-font: Fraunces Variable (Latin+LatinExt, tri-axis opsz/SOFT/WONK/wght) for Latin scripts; Literata Variable (Cyrillic+CyrillicExt, opsz+wght) for Ukrainian/Russian text. Browser font-matching selects per glyph via unicode-range in src/styles/fonts.css — no JS required. Georgia stays as universal fallback (Law 17 i18n safety).

body.$description: Body slot — default UI text, paragraphs, inputs, buttons. Inter Variable covers Latin + LatinExt + Cyrillic + CyrillicExt. font-display: optional prevents FOUT flash on hot path.

serif.$description: Serif alias — same as display. Use for prose passages, editorial pull-quotes, bound-book export styling. Same Phase 0-B.1 Fraunces+Literata dual-font unicode-range cascade for Cyrillic coverage.

hand.$description: Hand slot — gratitude entries, intimate annotations, handwritten moments. Caveat Variable (Latin+Cyrillic, wght 400-700). Use sparingly — reserve for emotional moments per typography-grammar.md §Sacred Moments.

mono.$description: Mono slot — reserved for tabular numerics (streak counters via font-feature-settings: 'tnum') and future code blocks. No bundled font this phase (system stack only).

sm.$description: 14px — secondary UI, form hints, list metadata.

tight.$description: Display/hero — compressed line-height for big sizes.

loose.$description: Gratitude handwriting, quote watermarks — breathing room.

tight.$description: Display headlines — tighten for visual balance at large sizes.

_placeholder.$value: Phase 0-B will populate elevation scale (sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, inner, glow, soft, card, hover).
Phase 0-B will populate duration scale (instant 0ms, fast 150ms, base 250ms, slow 400ms, slower 600ms, slowest 1000ms).
Phase 0-B will populate easing curves (linear, ease-in, ease-out, ease-in-out, spring, bounce).
Phase 0-B will populate z-index scale (base 0, dropdown 10, sticky 20, nav 50, modal 60, overlay 70, tooltip 80, toast 90).
